geneva_9.ttf: "Geneva 9" by Kelsey Higham (2010), made with FontStruct
(http://fontstruct.fontshop.com), a pixel copy of the Mac's Geneva 9 bitmap font.
Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
tools/fontgen.py takes the 9-point ASCII glyphs of mactb/font_data.c from it.
